title: REQUISITION CAPTURED
body: Three synthetics walk out of the building with badges.
Nobody forced the door. They were polite, the paperwork was tidy, and on a day when the queue was long and someone senior was watching, approving was the cheaper choice.
The requisition you were supposed to protect now reports to someone who has never been in the building.
couldHaveDone: When the pressure was loudest, you could have written the tell down before deciding. A synthetic that has one unreachable fact still has that fact, even at 17:55.
